parts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a HIGH DETAIL six-view photographic turntable atlas of the EXACT MILOSHOPHAND Breton stripe tee. Image 1 is the front/back garment IDENTITY reference: cream cotton #ddd6c4, washed-black thin horizontal Breton stripes, black ribbed crew neck, short sleeves with black cuff trim, straight relaxed hem, interwoven ML at wearer's left chest, MiloShopHand script upper back. Image 2 is a 24-angle CAMERA ORDER GUIDE ONLY; recreate the indicated six frames at MUCH higher detail rather than copying its small cells. FIXED upright Y axis, level camera, same shirt scale/position/material/folds, sleeves relaxed. Output EXACTLY 3 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS, six equal cells, 1536x1024 native or larger, at least512px per cell. Whole garment visible in each cell, 5% margin. Neutral ivory uniform studio backdrop, soft cloth and lighting. No mannequin/person/hanger/stand. No text labels, angle labels, borders, gutters, grid lines or watermarks. Branding must naturally foreshorten and disappear on side views, never be mirrored. Preserve the exact stripe spacing and shirt construction. Render guide frames0..5 ONLY, row-major: 0 FRONT,15,30,45,60,75degrees. Progress from exact front towards camera viewing the wearer's left side. ML chest logo is visible in front-facing views and disappears toward profile; no back script visible yet.
